en: The image is an old black and white postcard showing a snow-covered square or street, surrounded by grand stone buildings. There is visible snow piled up with faint silhouettes of people walking. At the top left of the front, the text reads 'Sundsvall. Vängåfvan.' Handwritten text appears in red in the top right. The reverse side includes handwritten text in Swedish, address lines, and a prominently stamped date: 5 FEB 1909. The publisher is noted as 'C. N:s Lj., Sthlm.'
